scientific_integrity: The universal nonnegativity claim is proved by an exact two-point upper certificate and an exact Bernstein-positive factorization. Equality is reconstructed from the contact and derivative conditions.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the real even support \(H=\{3,7\}\). It does not classify all two-element supports. The exact proof is analytic; the originality conclusion is based on targeted database, own-ledger, and primary-literature comparisons and retains a residual risk of older equivalent notation.
title: Exact sparse Carathéodory–Fejér constant for \(H=\{3,7\}\)
